reader_summary.headline: On today's Manager Meeting, Tim McCusker interviews Jack Sommers.
reader_summary.overview: On today's Manager Meeting, Tim McCusker interviews Jack Sommers. Tim is the CIO at NEPC and a past guest on Capital Allocators. He oversees investment research and strategy for the $1.5 trillion consultant. Jack is the co-founder and Executive Chair at Income Research and Management, a $90B core fixed income investment firm.

key_points.text: He was instrumental in developing IR+M's disciplined bottom-up investment approach and served as a Portfolio Manager for 20 years.
Their conversation covers the early days of IR+M, when Jack and his father faced the challenges of establishing an investment management business.
